law_record.title: Stopping, standing or parking prohibited in specified places (1)(o)
law_record.text: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device, in any of the following places: At any place where official traffic-control devices prohibit stopping, standing or parking.
